channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: All-Ireland winning goalkeeper rejoins Tipp hurling squad
item.description: Brian Hogan has returned to the Tipperary senior hurling fold ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: The 2026 GAA fixture schedule in full
item.description: The GAA's master fixtures schedule for 2026 has been released.

item.title: GAA's National Demographics Committee Report launched
item.description: The GAA has today published a set of recommendations aimed at targeting the dramatic demographic changes which have taken place in Ireland, and which are having a significant impact on rural and urban clubs.

item.title: New joint hurling managers and jersey for Louth
item.description: Paddy McArdle and Diarmuid Murphy have been appointed joint-managers of the Louth senior hurlers.

item.title: Smyth set for second Saints start after impressive debut
item.description: Charlie Smyth will be first-choice kicker for the New Orleans Saints again this weekend after impressing on his NFL debut last week.

item.title: Tipp All-Ireland winner takes Carlow camogie reins
item.description: Carlow Camogie have appointed former Tipperary hurling star Paul Kelly as their new intermediate manager.

item.title: Donegal launch new jersey
item.description: Donegal have become the latest county to unveil a new jersey design ahead of the 2026 season.

item.title: First anniversary Mass for Jody Gormley
item.description: The first anniversary Mass for Jody Gormley takes place this weekend.

item.title: GAA on TV: Leinster and Munster finals take centre stage
item.description: The live TV action comes from Croke Park and FBD Semple Stadium this weekend where Leinster champions in football and hurling, and Munster champions in football, are set to be crowned.

item.title: Donegal and Limerick spend over €2m on county teams
item.description: Donegal and Limerick have joined Galway and Kerry in spending over €2 million on their county teams this year.
